log: |rule|Species Clause: Limit one of each Pokémon

decisions.thought: Plan: Mirror match, bring Mega Dragonite lead to DD, Scarf Gholdengo to revenge, BulkUp Ape to beat Kingambit and stall Rotom. Dragonite weak only to Focus Blast here, so setup is safe. Keep Multiscale intact, save Ape for late.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing a Gen 9 mirror team matchup to select three Pokémon while evaluating Mega Evolution and role matchups.Evaluating type interactions and move effectiveness for the mirror matchup.Comparing coverage and speed control to choose the final three Pokémon for the mirror matchup.Evaluating speed tiers and type matchups to resolve the Dragonite and Gholdengo interaction.

decisions.thought: Plan: DD on Kingambit lead, exploit Multiscale + Sucker Punch fail. Then EQ / Mega sweep. Save Annihilape with Drain Punch for Kingambit if Dragonite fails, Gholdengo Scarf to revenge fast threats. Scout Kingambit move first.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Resolving a contradiction between the stated mirror-match rule and the listed opponent team composition.Clarifying the team composition discrepancy and evaluating the Dragonite versus Kingambit matchup.Analyzing damage calculations and ability interactions for the Dragonite and Kingambit matchup.Evaluating Dragonite's Dragon Dance versus Kingambit to preserve Multiscale and scout the Mega ability.

decisions.thought: Plan: Stay base to keep Multiscale, OHKO +2 Kingambit with +1 EQ. Survive Sucker Punch via Multiscale. Save Mega for later sweep, keep Ape for Kingambit backup, Scarf Gholdengo to revenge.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Resolving a contradiction about whether the opponent team is an exact copy of the player's team.Clarifying team composition rules and evaluating Mega Dragonite ability uncertainty for the next move.

decisions.thought: Plan: KO +2 Kingambit with priority ESpeed before Sucker Punch kills. Mega now to sweep. Opp Kingambit has SD + Sucker, 19% HP. Keep Scarf Gholdengo to revenge, Ape with Drain for late. Dragonite at +1/+1.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating move priority and damage to choose between Earthquake and ExtremeSpeed for the KO.Resolving the priority and damage calculation to confirm the KO before Sucker Punch.

decisions.thought: Plan: KO +4 Kingambit with ESpeed priority beats Sucker Punch. Keep +1/+1 Mega Dragonite to sweep, Scarf Gholdengo to revenge, Ape with Drain as backup. Opp has 2 mons left unknown.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating damage calculations and move priority to choose between Extreme Speed and Earthquake for Dragonite versus Kingambit.

decisions.thought: Plan: KO Volc with EQ then ESpeed priority even if it Quivers. Avoid contact burn so EQ first. Keep +1/+1 Mega Dnite sweep, Scarf Gholdengo revenge, Ape backup. Opp Volc unknown moves, Kingambit gone with SD+Sucker.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Mega Dragonite's +1 speed advantage against Volcarona and calculating Earthquake damage to choose the optimal move.Resolving the Bug/Fire type interaction to confirm Earthquake is neutral damage.Evaluating Roost versus Dragon Dance to restore Multiscale while managing the speed and damage risk.Assessing Earthquake versus ExtremeSpeed against a potential Levitate switch and follow-up setup.

decisions.thought: Plan: KO +1 Volc with ESpeed priority before it outspeeds and KOs. Keep +1/+1 Mega Dnite, Scarf Gholdengo revenge, Ape backup. Opp Volc at 18% with QD, Kingambit gone.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Calculating damage and speed to confirm Extreme Speed KO on Volcarona at 18% HP.

decisions.thought: Plan: Rotom is last mon, Levitate blocks EQ and threatens burn. Sacrifice +1/+1 to block Wisp with Good as Gold Gholdengo, then KO with steel/ghost STAB. Keep half HP Dragonite ESpeed for finish, Ape backup.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Dragonite's move options against Rotom-Wash's type immunity and likely actions to choose the optimal turn.Assessing Gholdengo's Trick and status immunity versus Rotom-Wash compared to Annihilape and Dragonite options.Evaluating Trick on Gholdengo to lock Rotom-Wash and comparing it to direct attacks from Dragonite and Annihilape.Switching to Gholdengo to block Will-O-Wisp and secure a favorable damage trade against Rotom-Wash.

decisions.thought: Plan: Rotom is last mon, Kingambit and Volc fainted. Wall Wisp with Good as Gold Gholdengo and 2HKO with Shadow Ball STAB. Keep Mega Dragonite at 50% for ESpeed finish, Ape full backup.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Pokemon type matchup and damage calculation for Make It Rain against Rotom-Wash with Choice Scarf Gholdengo.Evaluating type effectiveness and move coverage for Gholdengo versus Rotom-Wash.Resolving speed calculation and item lock ambiguity, then selecting the neutral STAB move.Confirming the opponent's last Pokémon and that a KO ends the battle, then prioritizing the neutral STAB move.

decisions.thought: Plan: Rotom is last mon, others fainted. Stay with Scarf Gholdengo immune to Wisp, finish -1 SpD Rotom with Shadow Ball. Keep Mega Dragonite ESpeed and full Ape as backup.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Choice Scarf lock and damage to continue Shadow Ball versus switching, noting Rotom's HP and immunity.
